output.promotion_policy: Promote as a standalone sibling because product-level installment cash-flow analysis has a distinct user intent, independent inputs/outputs, deterministic implementation, and is not a bank-report subtask.

router.name: installment-cost-analysis
router.description: Calculate borrower-side all-in installment annualized cost from actual dated cash flows; use IRR/XIRR by default and show the book formula only as a labeled limited simple approximation.

promotion.gain_hypothesis: Compared with surface fee multiplication or the book shortcut alone, IRR/XIRR will correctly include actual proceeds, dates, compounding and all direct fees.
promotion.falsifier: The skill misroutes bank-statement fee questions, omits direct costs, or produces a different result from independently recomputed cash-flow IRR.
portfolio_conflicts: bank-comprehensive-analysis must redirect product-cost questions and retain accounting-classification questions
promotion.rationale: The legacy capability was unreachable from its router; a separate entrypoint has lower routing ambiguity than broadening the bank-report description.
